title: Strange Wills
identity_notes: Syndicated half-hour anthology built around unusual wills and inheritances. GRH contains 27 regular U.S. transfers representing 26 underlying program identities, plus one audition/sales presentation and six OTRR reference tracks. Market/distribution dates and numbering traditions conflict, so no single air-date or episode-number system is treated as universal.

eras.label: U.S. Teleways/Charles Michelson transcription run
eras.notes: Raw specialist records document 26 U.S. program identities distributed by Teleways/Charles Michelson; local station schedules varied.

historical_context.title: Postwar transcription syndication and local commercial insertion
historical_context.description: Strange Wills was distributed by Teleways/Charles Michelson as half-hour transcriptions with music fill for locally inserted commercials.

historical_context.title: Probate law as anthology framing device
historical_context.description: The series turns unusual wills and inheritance disputes into mystery, romance, crime and human-interest stories through John Francis O'Connell.

historical_context.title: Australian continuation/repackaging after the U.S. package
historical_context.description: Specialist records later preserve Grace Gibson/Charles Michelson programs under the same title/format; these are outside the 34-object GRH snapshot.
